# Narayan Sindur Udyog

> Narayan Sindur Udyog (NSU) is an Indian manufacturer and supplier of fluorescent pigment powders, classic sindoor colours, and high-performance colour solutions for plastics, masterbatch, printing inks, coatings, paper, and specialty industrial applications.

Narayan Sindur Udyog (NSU) delivers non-toxic, heavy-metal-free colour solutions engineered for high tinting strength, thermal stability, and clean dispersibility across industrial and decorative systems.

## Main Sections

- [Home](https://www.nsudyog.com/): Official website and company overview of Narayan Sindur Udyog.
- [Products](https://www.nsudyog.com/products): Complete product catalogue of fluorescent pigments, sindoor colours, and colour powders.
- [Applications](https://www.nsudyog.com/applications): Application guidance covering paints, plastics, inks, coatings, textiles, paper coating, and decorative preparations.
- [About Us](https://www.nsudyog.com/about): Company overview, manufacturing capabilities, quality philosophy, and background.
- [Global Markets](https://www.nsudyog.com/global-markets): Information for international buyers, export capabilities, and global trade partnerships.
- [Technical Resources](https://www.nsudyog.com/technical-resources): Technical documentation guidelines, TDS, SDS, and COA information.
- [Contact](https://www.nsudyog.com/contact): Direct enquiry channels, facility locations, telephone, and email.
